# genshin-guide — LLM / AI Discovery File (llms.txt)
# Teyvat Starter Guide: a beginner-friendly Genshin Impact guide.
# Bilingual (zh-CN / en). Use this to understand the site's structure
# before fetching individual pages for summarization or citation.

## Site Overview
A Genshin Impact starter guide covering character builds, artifacts, and
team composition. English (en) and Chinese (zh-CN) content both exist;
each English build page declares lang="en" + hreflang en/x-default and
carries Article + FAQPage structured data.

## Notes for AI crawlers
- robots.txt allows all user agents, including GPTBot, ClaudeBot,
  PerplexityBot, and Google-Extended (Allow: /).
- Each English build page carries both Article and FAQPage JSON-LD,
  which are the preferred blocks for answer extraction.
- Chinese-language per-character pages are planned; CN character content
  currently lives inline on the homepage.
